# THE TAUGHT CANFD LANE — every Python package it needs, and nothing else.
#
# What it covers: a drag-taught .txt recording -> the optimised, certified slot
# (tools/taught_pipeline.py) -> the run on the arm (tools/taught_tracks.py flow)
# -> the check (tools/motion_analysis/plot_runs.py). Install it with
#     ./tools/setup_taught_canfd.sh
# which makes a virtual environment, installs this file into it, and proves the
# lane runs. Nothing else from this repository has to be installed: every
# in-repo module the lane uses (alix_dispatch, alix_workspace's URDF
# kinematics, the exp01 emitter, the RealMan SDK submodule) is put on the path
# by the tools themselves.
#
# TESTED on Ubuntu 24.04 / Python 3.12.3 (2026-09-23) with two sets: the one
# this host has run the arm with (the version after each package below), and
# the one a fresh `setup_taught_canfd.sh` installed that day — numpy 2.5.3,
# scipy 1.18.1, toppra 0.6.10, PyYAML 6.0.3, matplotlib 3.11.2, tornado 6.5.10.
# The floor is the oldest release whose API the code uses; a newer one is
# expected to work, and `setup_taught_canfd.sh --check` proves it does.
#
# ROS is NOT needed. Nothing here talks to ROS, and no ROS workspace has to be
# sourced.

numpy>=1.26                 # tested 2.4.6  — every stage, and the FK
scipy>=1.11                 # tested 1.17.1 — Butterworth filters (signal), nearest point (spatial.cKDTree), rotations (spatial.transform)
toppra>=0.6                 # tested 0.6.9  — stage 4, the time-optimal re-timing
PyYAML>=6.0                 # tested 6.0.1  — the task manifests the certify/flow verbs read
matplotlib>=3.8             # tested 3.10.9 — the analysis figures (plot_runs.py, compare_tracks.py)
tornado>=6.3                # tested 6.4    — matplotlib's WebAgg server, which IS the default view
# pip pulls in what these need (pillow, contourpy, cycler, fonttools, kiwisolver, packaging,
# pyparsing, python-dateutil for matplotlib; nothing to add by hand).

# To run the test suites as well (not needed to use the lane):
#     pip install "pytest>=7" pytest-xdist
